notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
You control up to three lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
description:
Activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Frantic Search for its escape cost by paying {2}{U} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to loot twice and untap three lands.
Mesmeric Orb triggers three times, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat.
